model.rme_order: initial bra / final ket: a_L = <Ji||T_L||Jf>/sqrt(2L+1), real RB interaction RMEs
model.first_amplitude: A1_q(i,m) = sum_L q^pi_L sqrt(2L+1) a_L CG(2,L,2;m,i-m,i) d^L_(i-m,q)(theta1)
model.middle_density: R_mn = sum_(i,q1) w_i A1_q1(i,m) A1_q1(i,n)^* / (2 S1); Tr R = W1
model.joint_intensity: W12 = Tr(R F2) = sum_(i,q1,q2) w_i |sum_m A1_q1(i,m) A2_q2(m)|^2 / (4 S1 S2)
model.coherence: Intermediate m is summed coherently within each photon-helicity path, then squared. Initial i and unobserved q1,q2 are summed incoherently.
model.complex_conjugation_boundary: The source emission interaction amplitudes are conjugate to physical transition amplitudes; the selected meridian amplitudes are real, so coherent product probabilities agree.
model.rotation: SymPy1.14 wigner_d_small(L,-theta), then descending-to-ascending M conversion
model.geometry: Both phi=0 relative to a fixed initial alignment z axis; first photon and second photon polarizations unobserved.
model.positivity: R and F2 are weighted Gram matrices; W12 is a sum of nonnegative squared coherent amplitudes.
model.normalization: W1 and W12 are dimensionless synthetic intensities with full angular averages as specified below.

bounded_protocol.one_causal_expansion: theta1=pi/3, retain theta2=pi/4; no further angles or success search
bounded_protocol.reason: At theta1=0 the entire intermediate density is identical. Move gamma1 away from the initial alignment axis to permit conditional spin coherences in its frame.
bounded_protocol.termination: An exact pair-specific nonzero discriminant was found and random/dephasing/phase controls completed; no inverse classification or real DCO threshold is attempted.

pure_boundary.arbitrary_secondary_analyzer_certificate: R_a = R_b exactly; Tr(R_a F_any) = Tr(R_b F_any) for every fixed secondary analyzer, direction or polarization in this baseline.

full_support.arbitrary_secondary_analyzer_certificate: R_a = R_b exactly; Tr(R_a F_any) = Tr(R_b F_any) for every fixed secondary analyzer, direction or polarization in this baseline.

nonzero_difference_certificate.proof: Distinct positive square-free square roots, together with 1, are linearly independent over Q; at least one rational coefficient is nonzero.

ideal_dephasing.definition: Rotate R into the gamma1 spin frame, discard every offdiagonal element, and rotate back. This is an ideal diagnostic map, not an experimental deorientation model.

pure_boundary.definition: T_KQ(R) = sqrt5 sum_mn R_mn (-1)^(2-n) CG(2,2,K;m,-n,Q). These tensors use the intensity R; divide by W1 for normalized conditional statistical tensors.
pure_boundary.mechanism: In the gamma1 frame Z0 flips odd magnetic-projection coherences, equivalently odd Q components within even K tensors. It preserves diagonal populations and even Q. Odd Q is not an odd K tensor.

full_support.definition: T_KQ(R) = sqrt5 sum_mn R_mn (-1)^(2-n) CG(2,2,K;m,-n,Q). These tensors use the intensity R; divide by W1 for normalized conditional statistical tensors.
full_support.mechanism: In the gamma1 frame Z0 flips odd magnetic-projection coherences, equivalently odd Q components within even K tensors. It preserves diagonal populations and even Q. Odd Q is not an odd K tensor.

RB_cascade_phase_control.applicability: Random isotropic Ji=2 initial population and no other preselected axis; gamma1 = M1/E2 with delta1=1/2, gamma2 independently pure E2. Compact Eq3.73 is used only here.
RB_cascade_phase_control.boundary: The full cascade amplitudes already contain the source phases. No additional interference sign is inserted into them. The printed Eq3.73 lacks an explicit sum over K; the sum is restored from adjacent Eqs3.47 and 3.71.

normalization.sphere_moments_used: <nx^a ny^b nz^c>=0 if any exponent is odd, else (a-1)!!(b-1)!!(c-1)!!/(a+b+c+1)!!
normalization.integrate_secondary_FULL_solid_angle: Average_Omega2 W12 = W1 for arbitrary fixed first direction
normalization.meridian_boundary: No normalization claim is made for a theta-only meridian double integral. The full secondary azimuth is essential.

active_relation_and_passive_gauge.exact_relation: A_q(Ua,theta1) = -A_q(a,theta1) Z(theta1); R_b = Z R_a Z^T
active_relation_and_passive_gauge.Z: Z(theta1)=D^J2(theta1) diag((-1)^M) D^J2(theta1)^T: a pi spin rotation about the gamma1 direction
active_relation_and_passive_gauge.hypothesis_comparison: The nuclear basis and secondary E2 analyzer F2 are held fixed. The two amplitude hypotheses can give different conditional intermediate densities and different Tr(R F2). This is an active state relation between hypotheses; no physical rotation pulse is asserted.
active_relation_and_passive_gauge.passive_basis_change: Rotating both R and F2 by the same orthogonal Z leaves Tr(R F2) invariant, as checked exactly. A passive change of nuclear basis therefore cannot produce discrimination.

conclusion.baseline: For BOTH tested pairs R_a=R_b exactly, so every fixed secondary analyzer is blind at theta1=0. Linear first-photon xprime/yprime tags remain blind in this baseline.
conclusion.expanded_full_support: The supplied full-support pair also has an exact nonzero W12 difference at the single expanded geometry; the radical-basis certificate is stored above.
conclusion.mechanism: Nonuniform initial alignment permits offdiagonal middle-spin coherences in the gamma1 frame. U flips their odd magnetic-projection components. The fixed second E2 analyzer probes them; ideal gamma1-axis dephasing or a random initial state removes the difference.
conclusion.inverse_boundary: This separates this pair under the specified conditional model. It does not prove global uniqueness among all amplitudes, populations, spins, parities or cascade candidates.

required: known stated initial population and alignment axis
isolated coherent cascade with identified photon ordering
no intervening spin deorientation in the main model
real interaction amplitudes in the common RB convention
ideal point detector geometry and unobserved photon polarization
experimental_inputs_absent: intermediate lifetime and coincidence time window
before_experimental_discrimination: compare candidate likelihoods with actual counts and covariance
assumptions_and_experimental_boundary.DCO_boundary: All reported intensities and ratios are synthetic normalized quantities, not measured DCO values. No detector-specific DCO cutoff or significance is invented.
not_proved: a nucleus realizing these amplitude fractions
extension to other spins or complex amplitudes
